cand.title: XII Congreso Iberoamericano de Investigación Cualitativa en Salud
cand.organizationName: Red Iberoamericana de Investigación Cualitativa en Salud (REDIICS) / Universidad de Guadalajara
cand.excerpt: High event credibility and geographic fit; current-edition accessibility is constrained by a confirmed non-hotel venue, so the opportunity is ranked for overflow/ancillary or future capture rather than assumed open inventory.

quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: María Guadalupe Ramírez Contreras (Universidad de Guadalajara), president, and Katya Aurora Rábago Olivares (Universidad de Guadalajara), vice-president, are verified event leadership and appropriate routing contacts. Laura Rayas Andrade publicly lists Director de ventas at Pulso Eventos; she is a potential commercial intermediary, not a verified assigned CIICS account manager. None is established as hotel contract signatory.
findings.futureEdition: Confirmed XII edition on 26–29 October 2027, within the requested horizon. These are activity dates in the official FAQ and programme, not publication dates. Registration runs 17 August 2026–30 September 2027. Programme is subject to modification. No subsequent edition date or destination established.
findings.hotelProductFit: Inference using the supplied Sheraton Guadalajara Expo positioning: an Expo-adjacent full-service city hotel could fit delegate accommodation and small ancillary meetings better than a remote resort for this edition. The official visitor guide specifically recommends proximity to Hotel Barceló/Expo Guadalajara to minimize transfers. Do not assume the supplied 216 rooms are available or required; no event demand quantity is published in the reviewed material.
findings.venueCommitments: The seed’s non-hotel-venue premise is superseded: official FAQ, lodging page and programme identify Barceló Guadalajara as hotel headquarters, Av. de las Rosas 2933. Programme also identifies Paraninfo UDG, Av. Juárez 975, for the 26 October opening programme, following transfer from the hotel. This establishes announced venue commitment, not access to an executed contract or exclusivity terms.
findings.historicalRotation: REDIICS publishes an itinerant, biennial series: Guadalajara 2003; Madrid 2005; San Juan 2008; Fortaleza 2010; Lisbon 2012; Medellín 2014; Barcelona 2016; Florianopolis 2018; Montevideo 2021; Valladolid 2023; Santiago de Chile 2025. Gaps show this is not an annual series or a guaranteed two-year interval. Guadalajara returns in 2027. Earlier hotel-venue rotation is not established by this destination timeline.
findings.accommodationSourcing: Official lodging page directs attendees to Pulso Eventos’s event-specific hoteles convenio page, which publishes multiple accommodation offers and direct hotel reservation channels. This is an established accommodation pathway, not evidence that recruitment of additional hotels is open. Main venue: committed to Barceló; additional hotel sourcing: unknown. Pulso’s public group channel is grupos@pulsoeventos.com, +52 33 3647 0518, WhatsApp +52 33 1703 2527. No block quantity, pickup, release date, guaranteed room nights or RFP found.
findings.organizationStructure: REDIICS describes itself as an international nonprofit research network. The congress has Universidad de Guadalajara-based local leadership and an academic organizing/scientific committee. Pulso Eventos is a separate commercial event-services company, with its accommodation page linked by the organizer. Do not conflate the network, university organizer, hotel venue and accommodation intermediary; a full PCO mandate or legal procurement entity is not evidenced.
findings.competitiveLimitations: Barceló already holds the announced headquarters position and publishes event accommodation offers. The linked accommodation page has six hotel-offer entries, including Hostalia, Barceló, City Express Plus Guadalajara Expo, Villa del Sol and two Posadas reservation-channel offers. City Express Plus identity is corroborated by the official Marriott address. Existing alternatives demonstrate competition, not sell-out or unmet overflow. No documented overflow, incumbent capacity shortfall, exclusive accommodation clause or unmet room requirement found.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Contact the congress president/vice-president to confirm the accommodation decision-maker and introduce Sheraton as a potential additional Expo-area option, without proposing displacement of Barceló. In parallel ask Pulso’s groups desk, optionally routed to Laura Rayas Andrade, whether more hotels can join the 2027 list; request verified room-night/peak-night demand, existing commitments, rate targets, release terms and booking method. Offer a conditional accommodation proposal and only discuss ancillary meetings after identifying an uncommitted requirement. Monitor the 29 October 2027 next-host announcement; do not forecast a local repeat.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: As of 14 November 2026, the 2027 congress is future and confirmed, but not an open main-venue opportunity. Sheraton participation as an additional recommended hotel, delegate choice or ancillary venue remains unconfirmed. Published direct hotel booking instructions suggest attendee booking routes, not a centrally guaranteed room block.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Inference: build REDIICS/Universidad de Guadalajara and Pulso relationships now for additional 2027 lodging consideration and later Guadalajara-based programmes. International rotation means the next congress must not be assumed to return to Guadalajara. The 2027 programme schedules announcement of the next host at closing on 29 October; no future local date or open venue tender established.
